responsibility: Builds and manages MIR-to-backend debug information mappings for a function, including source scopes, inlined scopes, variable declarations, constant debug entries, per-local debug fragments, and projection-based offset calculations used when emitting variable locations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `traits/debuginfo.rs`, which defines abstract backend APIs, this file implements MIR-level debuginfo bookkeeping and lowering logic: scope maps, variable/constant debug records, fragment handling, and projection-based offset computation before calling backend hooks.
